NotificationIdentification.name: Notification Identification
NotificationIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the group of meeting notification messages when the notification is split in multiple (paginated) messages.

NotificationStatus.name: Notification Status
NotificationStatus.definition: Status of the details of the event.

ShareholderRightsDirectiveIndicator.name: Shareholder Rights Directive Indicator
ShareholderRightsDirectiveIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the announcement was initiated by the first intermediary in the custody chain in accordance with SRD II.

ConfirmationOfHoldingRequired.name: Confirmation Of Holding Required
ConfirmationOfHoldingRequired.definition: Indicates whether a specific confirmation of holding together with a participation and/or vote instruction is required by the issuer (for instance as required in the German Stock Corporation Act paragraph 67c section 3).
